Anyone can talk a good game on their third drink.

Kevin explains that you can't measure talk, so talk doesn't matter. What matters is what you can measure. He tells how Arnold Schwarzenegger picked his training partners: whoever held the title was the person he wanted to train with.

The same test works for choosing who you spend time with. Look at their results, not their words.

Who around you has real results in the area you want to grow?
